purpose: Large engineering waves with cheap deterministic checks during implementation and heavy proof only at milestone/release boundaries.
truthBoundary: Quick and domain gates are static/code-only diagnostics. Milestone gates require installed exact dependencies. Release gates are not LIVE proof.

cadence.quick: After a coherent code batch or before handoff; never after every edited line.
cadence.domain: Once after completing a whole domain wave.
cadence.milestone: Once at the end of a MEGA-WAVE.
cadence.release: Once for a release candidate, before browser/PDF/staging proof.

forbiddenShortcuts: Do not count quick/domain diagnostics as build, browser, staging or LIVE proof.
Do not execute milestone/release automatically from preinstall, dev or ordinary file edits.
Do not raise percentages from planned tests or inherited receipts.
